title: fix(ui): Navbar links overflow on mobile devices without hamburger toggle
description: On smaller screen viewports (mobile phones), the navigation links in the header stretch horizontally off the screen with no hamburger toggle or mobile drawer menu.
how_to_verify: Resize your browser window to mobile width (<640px). The navbar should display a clean hamburger menu button that opens a mobile navigation drawer or dropdown.

title: fix(a11y): Insufficient color contrast on post card branch and semester text
description: The branch and semester metadata on study post cards uses text-stone-400 on white backgrounds, failing WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility contrast standards.
how_to_verify: Run an accessibility contrast audit or check with Chrome DevTools. The metadata text should have at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the card background.

title: fix(ui): Inconsistent button styles across Feed and Help Board modals
description: Buttons in the modal forms use differing padding, font weights, and border radiuses. Standardize them to use the defined button classes in globals.css.
how_to_verify: Compare buttons across the feed sharing modal and help board ask modal. Both should have consistent padding, border styles, and hover states.

title: feat(ui): Add dark mode theme support with Tailwind
description: The application currently only supports light mode. Add dark mode classes and a theme toggle button in the navigation bar using Tailwind's dark variant.
how_to_verify: Toggle the theme button in the header. The application background, card surfaces, and text colors should switch smoothly to dark mode tones.

title: fix(ui): Footer does not stick to bottom on pages with short content
description: On pages with little content (like an empty search or 404), the footer floats in the middle of the screen instead of sticking to the bottom of the viewport.
how_to_verify: Open a page with short content. The footer should sit anchored at the bottom edge of the browser viewport.

title: fix(ui): Replace placeholder SVG emoji favicon with custom GDG brand icon
description: The site favicon is currently a placeholder emoji. Replace it with a dedicated Bennett University or GDG On Campus SVG / ICO favicon.
how_to_verify: Inspect the browser tab icon. It should display a crisp, custom vector brand icon.

title: fix(ui): Show student initials fallback when avatar image is missing
description: When a student profile lacks an avatar image, the avatar renders as a blank gray circle. It should render the student's capitalized initials (e.g., 'AK' for Arnav Katyal).
how_to_verify: Sign in as a user with no avatar or test an empty avatar URL. The avatar container should display their uppercase initials on a colored background.

title: fix(docs): Fix typo 'Calender' on Events page heading
description: The Events page title incorrectly spells Calendar as 'Calender'.
how_to_verify: Visit the /events route. The heading should read 'Campus Events & Calendar'.

title: fix(docs): Fix typo 'Reserverations' on Event details page
description: On the event details page, the registration count displays the misspelled word 'Reserverations'.
how_to_verify: Navigate to an event detail page. The counter card should read 'Current Reservations'.

title: fix(docs): Fix typo 'desciption' in Help Board form label
description: The question submission modal on the Help Board has a typo in the label: 'Problem desciption'.
how_to_verify: Open the 'Ask a Question' modal on /help. The textarea label should read 'Problem description *'.

title: fix(docs): Fix typo 'Informaton' in Useful Contacts header
description: The Useful Contacts page title displays 'Useful Campus Contacts & Informaton'.
how_to_verify: Navigate to /contacts. The heading should correctly read 'Useful Campus Contacts & Information'.

title: fix(docs): Fix typo 'Catagories' in Feed filter dropdown label
description: The category dropdown filter on the Study Feed is labeled 'Catagories'.
how_to_verify: Visit /feed. The fourth filter label should read 'Categories'.

title: fix(docs): Fix typo 'Semseter' on Student Profile page
description: The user profile subtitle incorrectly prints 'Semseter' instead of 'Semester'.
how_to_verify: Navigate to any student profile. The subtitle should read 'Branch: CSE • Semester 3'.

title: fix(docs): Fix typo 'comunity rules' in Campus Lounge banner
description: The community rules banner in the Campus Lounge chat contains the typo 'comunity'.
how_to_verify: Visit /chat. The banner title should read 'Campus Lounge community rules'.

title: fix(ui): Inconsistent heading capitalization on Study Feed
description: The Study Feed page uses lowercase 'student study feed' while other pages use Title Case.
how_to_verify: The heading on /feed should read 'Student Study Feed' matching other section headings.

title: docs: Fix typographical errors in README.md and complete the local Supabase section
description: The main README contains small typos and has an incomplete bullet point under the Supabase setup section.
how_to_verify: Review README.md. All sentences should be grammatically sound and the local setup instructions complete.

title: fix(a11y): Missing descriptive alt text on avatar and post images
description: Avatar and resource preview images have empty or missing alt attributes, impairing screen reader navigation.
how_to_verify: All elements should have descriptive alt text such as alt={`${author.name}'s avatar`}.

title: fix(a11y): Form inputs lack programmatic labels with htmlFor and id
description: Form input elements in the Help Board modal lack matching id and htmlFor attributes on their labels.
how_to_verify: Clicking any form label should immediately move keyboard focus into its corresponding input field.

title: fix(a11y): Form inputs remove focus outlines without accessible focus rings
description: Several text inputs specify focus:outline-none without providing an accessible replacement focus ring for keyboard navigation.
how_to_verify: Tab through the input fields using the Tab key. Each focused field should have an obvious, high-contrast focus ring.

title: fix(a11y): Replace clickable report div with semantic button element
description: The report action on study post cards uses an onClick on a plain <div> instead of an accessible <button> element with keyboard support.
how_to_verify: You should be able to tab to the report action and trigger it using the Enter or Space key.

title: fix(logic): Make Study Feed keyword search case-insensitive
description: Search queries currently use exact case matching in lib/db.js (post.title.includes(search)), which fails to match lowercase searches against capitalized titles.
how_to_verify: Searching for 'operating' on /feed should successfully return 'Operating Systems End-Term PYQs'.

title: fix(logic): Sort events chronologically with upcoming events first
description: Events are currently sorted oldest-first with past events mixed in. Sort them so upcoming events appear first, and filter out past events by default.
how_to_verify: Events with dates closest to today should appear at the top of /events.

title: fix(ui): Format raw ISO date strings into friendly localized dates
description: Post cards and event dates display raw timestamps like '2026-10-25T17:30:00Z' instead of human-friendly formats like 'Oct 25, 2026 • 5:30 PM'.
how_to_verify: Post cards and events should display clean, localized date strings.

title: fix(ui): Optimistically update upvote count when toggling upvote button
description: Clicking the upvote button toggles the button highlight but does not increment or decrement the visible upvote counter until page refresh.
how_to_verify: Clicking upvote on a post card should immediately increase the displayed counter by 1 without refreshing.

title: feat(ui): Add friendly empty-state illustration when feed filters match no posts
description: When filters or search results match zero posts, the feed displays blank empty space. It should display a clear empty-state message with a 'Clear Filters' button.
how_to_verify: Filter by a branch with no posts. An empty state card with 'No materials found' and a reset button should appear.

title: feat(ui): Add loading spinner and disable state to post and question forms
description: When publishing a post or question, there is no loading animation on the submit button, leaving users uncertain if the request is processing.
how_to_verify: Submitting a new study material should show a subtle loading spinner and disabled state on the publish button.

title: fix(ui): Persist feed filters in URL search query parameters
description: Feed filters currently reset whenever the user refreshes the page or navigates away. Store filter state in URL search parameters (e.g. ?branch=CSE&type=notes).
how_to_verify: Select a branch and semester filter on /feed, then refresh the browser. The filters should remain selected.

title: fix(ui): Display specific server-side validation error messages in feed form
description: When an API returns a specific validation error (e.g., URL protocol required), ensure the error message is rendered clearly above the form.
how_to_verify: Attempt to submit an invalid post without checking the rights confirmation. A clear, specific error banner should appear.

title: feat(feed): Implement pagination or infinite scroll for study feed
description: The Study Feed currently returns all matching resources in a single query. Implement pagination controls (Previous/Next) or an offset limit.
how_to_verify: The feed should display a maximum of 10 posts per page with working pagination buttons.

title: fix(chat): Automatically scroll Campus Lounge to newest message
description: The chat message container does not automatically scroll to the bottom when new messages arrive or when the chat page loads.
how_to_verify: Open /chat or send a message. The chat window should smoothly auto-scroll to the newest message at the bottom.

title: fix(chat): Format Campus Lounge timestamps into relative time
description: Chat timestamps currently show raw ISO strings. Format them into relative time (e.g. '5m ago', 'just now') or local time (e.g. '10:45 AM').
how_to_verify: Chat messages should show compact, readable time like '11:20 AM' or '3m ago'.

title: fix(ui): Fix pluralization grammar on profile post count
description: When a student has authored exactly 1 post, the profile header shows '1 posts'. Fix pluralization to say '1 post'.
how_to_verify: View a profile with 1 post. It should display '1 post published to the student feed'.

title: feat(feed): Add delete button for authors on their own posts in UI
description: The backend API endpoint /api/posts/[id] supports post deletion by authors, but no delete button is rendered in the PostCard component.
how_to_verify: When logged in as the author of a post, a 'Delete' button should appear and successfully remove the post.

title: feat(feed): Add 'Copy Link' share button to study post cards
description: Students cannot easily copy a direct shareable link to a study material. Add a 'Copy Link' button that writes the resource link or card URL to the clipboard.
how_to_verify: Click 'Copy Link' on any post. A toast notification should confirm the link was copied to the clipboard.

title: feat(events): Add 'Add to Google Calendar' button on event detail page
description: Add an 'Add to Google Calendar' link on event detail pages so students can easily add campus sessions to their university schedule.
how_to_verify: Click 'Add to Google Calendar' on an event page. It should open Google Calendar with prefilled title, description, and time.

title: feat(help): Enable filtering help requests by clicking tag chips
description: Tags on Help Board questions are rendered as chips, but clicking a tag does not filter the question list by that tag.
how_to_verify: Click on a tag like '#pointers'. Only questions containing that tag should be displayed in the list.

title: feat(feed): Improve 'For You' recommendation algorithm with semester and upvote weighting
description: The 'For you' tab in lib/db.js only checks branch equality. Enhance the algorithm to prioritize the student's exact semester and sort by upvote score.
how_to_verify: Posts matching both the user's branch and semester with high upvotes should rank at the top of the 'For You' tab.

title: feat(ui): Add custom themed 404 Not Found page
description: The app currently renders the default Next.js 404 page. Create a custom app/not-found.js with campus branding and quick links.
how_to_verify: Navigate to /non-existent-url. A clean, styled 404 page with navigation links back to the dashboard should appear.

title: feat(seo): Add Open Graph social preview metadata tags
description: Add Open Graph and Twitter card metadata (og:title, og:description, og:image) to app/layout.js for social sharing previews.
how_to_verify: Inspect the rendered HTML head tag. Proper <meta property='og:title'> and related tags should be present.

title: feat(profile): Add inline bio editing modal directly on profile page
description: Students cannot edit their bio or branch details from their profile page. Add an 'Edit Profile' button and modal for the logged-in user on /u/[id].
how_to_verify: Click 'Edit Profile' on your own profile. Update your bio and save; the changes should reflect immediately.

title: feat(feed): Add 'Sort by Most Upvoted' option on Study Feed
description: The feed is currently only sorted chronologically. Add a sort dropdown with options for 'Newest' and 'Most Upvoted'.
how_to_verify: Select 'Most Upvoted' on /feed. Resources with the highest upvote counts should appear at the top.

title: feat(contacts): Add real-time search input on Useful Contacts page
description: The Useful Contacts directory lacks a search bar, requiring students to manually scroll through categories to find phone numbers or emails.
how_to_verify: Type 'Hostel' in the search box on /contacts. Only matching contacts should remain visible in real time.

title: refactor(code): Remove duplicated event card markup across dashboard and events page
description: Event card rendering logic is duplicated between app/page.js and app/events/page.js. Extract into a reusable components/EventCard.js component.
how_to_verify: Events on both the home dashboard and events listing should be rendered via the extracted EventCard component.

title: refactor(code): Replace ambiguous single-letter variables x and d in lib/db.js
description: In lib/db.js, post filtering logic uses unclear single-letter variable names. Refactor to descriptive names like 'filteredPosts'.
how_to_verify: Inspect lib/db.js. All variables should have clear, self-documenting names.

title: test: Set up automated unit test runner (Vitest) and add first test suite
description: The repository currently has no test framework configured. Set up Vitest or Jest and write unit tests for input sanitization helpers in lib/validate.js.
how_to_verify: Running 'npm test' should execute and pass unit test suites for lib/validate.js.

title: docs: Add complete JSDoc annotations to lib/db.js data access functions
description: Core data access functions in lib/db.js lack JSDoc comments explaining parameters and return types.
how_to_verify: All exported functions in lib/db.js should have complete JSDoc blocks with @param and @returns documentation.

title: content: Add missing Dean of Student Affairs and Sports Complex entries to contacts.json
description: The placeholder contacts directory in data/contacts.json is missing key university departments including the Sports Complex and Dean of Student Affairs.
how_to_verify: data/contacts.json should include structured entries for Dean of Student Affairs and Sports Complex Facilities.
